name: io.github.A1-x-Tech/mcp-google-drive
title: Google Drive MCP
description: MCP server for the Google Drive API: search, upload, download, organize and share files.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_DRIVE_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Google OAuth2 client secret (refresh-token flow). Treat it as a secret.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_DRIVE_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Google OAuth2 refresh token, exchanged for access tokens automatically. Treat it as a secret.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_DRIVE_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Static OAuth2 access token (~1h lifetime) — alternative to the refresh-token trio, mostly for testing.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_DRIVE_OAUTH_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Fixed port for the loopback listener of the in-chat login (127.0.0.1 + PKCE). Set it when the client runs over SSH port forwarding; otherwise a free port is picked per login.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_DRIVE_MAX_RETRIES
environmentVariables.description: Retries on transient errors (429 always; 5xx/network for reads).
